## Activity

During February 2026, Market Eye Clinic completed 371 captures. The activity was delivered through the clinic’s planned operating arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Overall, the recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

There were 62 ungradable captures during the month. The ungradable rate was 16.7 per cent. This indicates that a proportion of completed captures could not be used for grading and may require attention through the usual image-acquisition and review processes. The ungradable total and rate should be considered alongside the overall activity level of 371 captures.

## Grading

A total of 83 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This provides an indication of the time between capture and completion of grading during February 2026. The grading results should be reviewed together with the image-quality findings, including the 62 ungradable captures and the ungradable rate of 16.7 per cent, to support routine monitoring of service delivery at Market Eye Clinic.
